benchmark.note: Planned fixed baseline, not yet reproducible and not an asserted optimal start; record exact start date, character ID, complete game rules, checksum, DLC fingerprint, and randomness controls before promotion.

eligibility_gate.rule: Filter out every invalid run before strategy scoring or comparison; validity is not a lower-priority optimization objective.

opening_budget.hypothesis: Prefer health, longevity, fertility, income, and expansion multipliers because the complete post-shop, post-first-session absolute snapshot becomes the growth baseline.
opening_budget.baseline_capture: Includes starting scored state, all shop effects, unspent budget converted to gold, and either the accepted first blessing plus chosen curse or seal, or a first-session refusal with no blessing or curse.
opening_budget.baseline_depression_hypothesis: A survivable first-session penalty that is later recovered may lower the baseline, but this must be tested against its survival and development cost.

resource_thresholds.influence_status: Runtime validation is required for hidden influence under governments without government_has_influence; scoring and mod effects are not government-gated.
resource_thresholds.rule: Invest resources between dynamic 2^n thresholds; preserve a crossed threshold when death risk rises.

realm_thresholds.rule: Track the next 2^n realm-size threshold dynamically; practical reach is bounded by the map rather than a hard-coded 512 target.

titles.rule: Value only titles still personally held at death, and optimize the net death snapshot against the complete growth baseline; transiently acquired titles do not score.

dynasty.rule: Prefer same-house living descendants; arrange marriages and land adult branches only when succession and realm stability remain acceptable.
dynasty.marriage_heuristic: Sons patrilineal and daughters matrilineal is only a common heuristic; verify each descendant's dynasty and house because doctrines, acceptance, and cadet branches can change the result.

sequence: Choose, reroll, or decline among three visible blessings before curses are drawn
After accepting a blessing, choose one of two visible curses or spend a seal; decline is no longer available
bargains.blessing_decision_rule: Compare visible blessing leverage plus bargain-pair XP and milestone value against conditional expected curse risk, survival effects, the three-year opportunity cost, and a decline penalty of 0.01 times expected pre-rejection track subtotal.
bargains.curse_decision_rule: After blessing acceptance, choose the lower-loss visible curse or use a seal according to current and future token value.
bargains.progression_opportunity_cost: Accepting a blessing and then choosing a curse or spending a seal completes the session and grants one Glassfire Gaze XP; declining forfeits that XP and progress toward 10-point attribute and token milestones.

survival.rule: Avoid commanding armies, control stress, obtain visible medical support, and reduce risky travel when expected life value dominates.
